notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Isochron Scepter to become a 4/4 artifact creature.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat from step 3.
